All615 original requirement identities, original source/version variants and separately allocated presentations remain owed. Facet links are scope bookkeeping, not wholesale source retirement or a newly imposed full-bibliography dependency expansion.

The broad measure/limit/martingale/Bayesian/identification/mediation treatments not wholly read in this block remain unassessed, even where authors reported complete returns. Their headings and old flags are not authorship evidence by themselves.

Missing is bounded to the named allocated source presentation/contribution. Related modern mathematics, historical mentions, another source/version and cross-part interfaces do not discharge it; it does not mean the topic is absent everywhere.

Reader bodies were read to the extents stated per row. Relevant author/source residual paragraphs were read; other hashed source notes are retained candidate locators, not claimed complete readings or manuscript treatments.

Later measurable-causal-graph work closes the older mediation global-Markov prerequisite. Only the remaining multiple-mediator/eAppendix/path-specific obligations are retained as partial, not the stale prerequisite.

Actual source-survey limitations, absent raw records or scientifically open questions are not invented missing-proof obligations. Specific allocated source/version, argument/proof and reproduction gaps stay explicit.

No independent correctness/source/admission review, source acquisition, new tests, manuscript build/render or manuscript/shared-progress/canonical/baseline mutation was performed. Continuing authoring can invalidate this snapshot.
